combined inhibition of CD14 and complement attenuated inflammation in response to increasing bacterial load in human whole blood.
combined inhibition of CD14 and complement is a potential therapeutic option for the prevention of Gram‐negative and possibly Gram‐positive sepsis.
the effect of combined complement inhibition and CD14 inhibition was generally preserved during escalating bacterial concentration.
